applicability_reference.identity_definition: Aligned identity over the 30 columns, excluding columns that are gap in both sequences.

benchmark_context.external_evaluation: Mixed result on 15 published designs: the GCGR point error was lower but its dependence-aware interval crossed zero, while pooled GLP-1R error was worse versus tied 1-NN; no overall superiority.
benchmark_context.metric_note: Development out-of-fold MAE is population-level benchmark context, not an individual prediction interval.

endpoint.warning: Functional potency only; not binding affinity, efficacy, safety, or clinical activity.

input_contract.alignment_policy: Input must already be aligned. Product code must not infer alignment, trim residues, or encode noncanonical chemistry.

provenance.fit_contract: All 125 development records, component-balanced weights, ridge alpha selected by leave-one-development-component-out two-receptor MAE.
provenance.primary_source: Puszkarska et al., Nature Chemistry (2024), doi:10.1038/s41557-024-01532-x
